DIAGNOSTICS SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM
7 I Check airbag sensor assembly.
PREPARATION: Door Side Airbag
Sensor(RH) (a) Turn the ignition switch to LOCK.
(b) Disconnect negative (-) terminal cable from the battery,
Airbag and wait at least for 90 seconds.
I I) I Sensor (c) Connect the door side airbag sensor (RH) connector and Assembly
airbag sensor assembly connector.
(d) Connect negative (-) terminal cable to the battery, and
wait at least for 2 seconds.
CHECK:
(a) Turn the ignition switch to ON, and wait at least for 20 se-
conds.
DLC3 (b) Clear the OTC stored in memory (See page D1-326).
OTC 81142/81143/34 (c) Turn the ignition switch to LOCK, and wait at least for 20
seconds.
(d) Turn the ignition switch to ON, and wait at least for 20 se­
conds.
(e) Check the DTC (See page D1-326).
OK: ..... _,, H10600 H09007 OTC 34 Is not output.
HINT:
Codes other than code 34 may be output at this time, but they
) are not relevant to this check.
Replace airbag sensor assembly. 8
From the results of the above Inspection, the malfunctionlng part can now be considered normal.
To make sure of this, use the simulation method to check.
